instruction: Please make all the text in the document italic.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires applying italic formatting to all text. Evaluator checks that >= 99% of text runs have italic property set to True.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator only checks text in paragraphs (doc.paragraphs), missing tables, headers, footers, and other document elements
Instruction requires 'all text' to be italic but verification is incomplete
For documents with only paragraph text, the logic would work correctly
The 99% threshold is appropriate and error handling is present
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add table text verification by iterating through doc.tables and checking run.italic for all table cells
Add header/footer verification using doc.sections[].header and .footer to check all header/footer runs
